# webmcp-go (Go, net/http)

> Server-side WebMCP toolkit for Go net/http, standard library only: validated tool definitions, per-page script-safe manifests for html/template, the shared browser runtime via embed, declarative form attribute helpers and Origin Trial middleware.

- Spec baseline: WebMCP Draft Community Group Report, 2026-10-02 (https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/). Browser API: `document.modelContext.registerTool()`, `getTools()`, `executeTool()` (formerly `navigator.modelContext`, deprecated in Chrome 150; the runtime falls back to it).
- Install: `go get github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go@latest` and import it as `webmcp "github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go"`.
- Requirements: Go >= 1.22, standard library only.
- Registry: [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go). License: MIT. Status: 0.x.
- Browser support: Chrome 149+ via origin trial (149–156, extension requested to 162) or `chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing`. Verified in Chrome 154.
- Not an MCP server library: WebMCP tools run in the user's browser tab. For desktop/CLI agents use an MCP SDK.
- Public API: `NewTool(Def)`, `NewRegistry(Transport)`, `Registry.Register` / `.Freeze` / `.Manifest(names...)`, `Manifest.ScriptTag(ScriptTagOptions)`, `RuntimeHandler()`, `RuntimeScriptTag(src, nonce)`, `FormAttrs`, `ParamAttr`, `OriginTrial`, `OriginTrialWithOptions`, `OriginTrialMetaTag`. Types `Def`, `Endpoint`, `Annotations`, `Transport`, `CSRF`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go/blob/main/README.md): what it does, install, quick start, intent, security model, troubleshooting
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go/blob/main/AGENTS.md): integration recipe, invariants, verification for coding agents
- [Security model](https://github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go/blob/main/README.md#security-model): same-origin endpoints, no redirects, per-call CSRF, declared parameters only, outcome envelopes, no retries
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go/blob/main/README.md#troubleshooting): exact error messages and fixes
- [Conformance fixtures](https://github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go/tree/main/conformance): shared manifest v1 fixtures and the pinned runtime hash
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/seunghan91/webmcp-go/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
